objective: Close 2027 with the year's second-biggest month: renewals banked before the shutdown, January pre-orders locked in December, and the year's data turned into a reason to come back.
strategy:
Wrapped.

Commercial job: Close 2027 with the year's second-biggest month: renewals banked before the shutdown, January pre-orders locked in December, and the year's data turned into a reason to come back.

Newcomer: Kickstart 21: Pre-Order (“Book January in December. 20% off.”). January is the strongest new-client month; selling the cohort in December fills it before the year turns and gives the buyer a deadline to hold.

Newcomer: Gift the Shake (“A pack of classes, wrapped. Twelve of them.”). Last-minute gifting at the desk: the pack needs no onboarding and converts in one visit.

Winback: Your 2027 Wrapped (“Your year in 12 numbers. Then a reason to start 2028.”). Data-led, screenshot-friendly and deeply personal; it is the only message a lapsed client will actually read in December.

Renewal: Wrapped & Renewed (“Renew in December, skip the January queue.”). Members who renew before the shutdown carry attendance into January; the queue-skip is worth more than a deeper discount.

Renewal: 12 Days of Shakemas (“Twelve days, twelve drops, one renewal.”). A daily reveal gives the studio a reason to message every member each day of the quietest fortnight, and each drop is small enough to protect the ticket.
notes:
Moment: Your 2027 Wrapped: a personal year-in-numbers card (and a 45-second film for the top 57 attendees), revealed 12 Dec; 12 Days of Shakemas runs 12–23 Dec, one drop a day.
Build: new clients 46 buyers = ₹4.0L; reactivation 38 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.3L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹6.1L (gift packs and retail peak); renewals ₹24.1L. First visits needed 119; CRM leads needed 148.

items.detail: Set up Kickstart 21: Pre-Order in Momence (1–31 Dec.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) plus a pre-ordered place in Kickstart 21 (4–24 Jan) — paid in December, starts in January.
Set up Gift the Shake in Momence (1–24 Dec.): A 12-class pack at 20% off (₹15,750), gift-wrapped at the desk with a printed card.
Set up Your 2027 Wrapped in Momence (1–31 Dec.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) — your 2027 Wrapped card, and 2 bonus classes if you buy before 20 Dec.
Set up Wrapped & Renewed in Momence (1–31 Dec.): 3 Months at 15% off (₹49,177) or 6 Months at 20% off (₹90,972) — no January queue, first choice of class times in the new year.
Set up 12 Days of Shakemas in Momence (12–23 Dec.): 12% off any renewal, plus one daily drop — 12–23 Dec, one reveal a day.
Brief the team on the 5 December offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Kickstart 21: Pre-Order to First-time clients.
Launch Gift the Shake to Members and clients gifting at Christmas.
Launch Your 2027 Wrapped to Lapsed clients.
Launch Wrapped & Renewed to Members expiring Dec–Jan.
Launch 12 Days of Shakemas to All members, every day 12–23 Dec.
Publish Your 2027 Wrapped on 12 Dec: personal cards for every client, a studio-wide film, and a Wrapped wall for the top 57 attendees.

Weekly check: Kickstart 21: Pre-Order: Pre-orders banked (target 20); January start rate. | Gift the Shake: Packs sold; recipients activating (target 65%). | Your 2027 Wrapped: Cards opened; lapsed purchases. | Wrapped & Renewed: Renewals banked before 24 Dec. | 12 Days of Shakemas: Daily drop redemptions; renewals on 12%.
Mid-month review against ₹38.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 200 renewals, 60 reactivations and 46 new buyers (140 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Run 12 Days of Shakemas day by day (12–23 Dec); publish each reveal in the studio stories and hold stock at the desk.
Bank renewals before the shutdown: every December expiry gets a call by 24 Dec.
Close 31 Dec at 23:59; hand the January Kickstart cohort list and pre-orders to the January plan.
